title: City & Places
description: Learn to talk about your city, describe places and landmarks, ask for and understand directions, and discuss transportation in Spanish.

grammar.title: ¿Dónde está...? — Asking for Locations
grammar.content:
To ask where something is, use the question word "dónde" (where) with the verb "estar" (to be, for location).

Basic pattern:
¿Dónde está + [singular noun]? (Where is [singular]?)
¿Dónde están + [plural noun]? (Where are [plural]?)

Examples:
¿Dónde está el banco? (Where is the bank?)
¿Dónde está la farmacia? (Where is the pharmacy?)
¿Dónde está el museo? (Where is the museum?)
¿Dónde está la estación de tren? (Where is the train station?)
¿Dónde están los baños? (Where are the bathrooms?)
¿Dónde está el centro? (Where is the center?)

Using "hay" (there is/are):
¿Hay un banco cerca? (Is there a bank nearby?)
¿Hay una farmacia aquí? (Is there a pharmacy here?)
¿Hay un museo cerca de aquí? (Is there a museum near here?)

Common place vocabulary:
- ¿Dónde está...? = Where is...?
- ¿Dónde hay...? = Where is/are there...?
- cerca = near
- lejos = far
- aquí = here
- allí = there
- acá = here (Latin America)
examples:
¿Dónde está la iglesia? (Where is the church?)
La iglesia está en la plaza. (The church is in the square.)
¿Dónde está el hospital? (Where is the hospital?)
El hospital está al lado del parque. (The hospital is next to the park.)
¿Dónde está el aeropuerto? (Where is the airport?)
El aeropuerto está lejos del centro. (The airport is far from the center.)
¿Dónde están los baños? (Where are the bathrooms?)
Los baños están en la esquina. (The bathrooms are at the corner.)

grammar.title: Directions — Giving and Understanding Directions
grammar.content:
Key phrases for giving directions in Spanish:

Basic directions:
Siga derecho / Todo recto = Go straight ahead
Gire a la izquierda = Turn left
Gire a la derecha = Turn right
Vaya a la derecha = Go to the right
Vaya a la izquierda = Go to the left

Additional directions:
Cruce la calle = Cross the street
Pase de largo = Go past
Llegará a... = You will arrive at...
Está a la izquierda/derecha = It's on the left/right

Polite request phrases:
¿Me puede decir cómo llegar a...? = Can you tell me how to get to...?
¿Sabes dónde está...? = Do you know where... is?
Disculpe, ¿dónde está...? = Excuse me, where is...?
Perdón, ¿puede ayudarme? = Sorry, can you help me?

Distance expressions:
- está lejos = it's far
- está cerca = it's near
- está a dos manzanas = it's two blocks away
- está a cinco minutos = it's five minutes away
- está a la vuelta = it's just around the corner

Prepositions for locations:
- al lado de = next to
- enfrente de = opposite
- entre = between
- en la esquina = at the corner
- en la plaza = in the square
- en el centro = in the center
- en la calle = on the street
examples:
Disculpe, ¿dónde está la estación de tren? (Excuse me, where is the train station?)
Siga derecho dos calles y gire a la izquierda. (Go straight for two streets and turn left.)
¿Cómo llego al museo? (How do I get to the museum?)
Cruce la calle y siga derecho. (Cross the street and go straight ahead.)
El museo está enfrente de la iglesia. (The museum is opposite the church.)
Está a la vuelta de la esquina. (It's just around the corner.)
¿Está lejos del centro? (Is it far from the center?)
No, está a cinco minutos a pie. (No, it's five minutes on foot.)
Está al lado del banco. (It's next to the bank.)
Cruce el puente y llegará al castillo. (Cross the bridge and you'll arrive at the castle.)

grammar.title: Transportation Vocabulary & Expressions
grammar.content:
Common transportation vocabulary:

Modes of transport:
el autobús = the bus
el metro = the subway
el tren = the train
el taxi = the taxi
el coche = the car
la bicicleta = the bicycle
el avión = the airplane
el barco = the boat
camino a pie = on foot

Transportation places:
la estación de autobuses = the bus station
la estación de metro = the subway station
la parada de autobús = the bus stop
la parada de taxi = the taxi stand
la estación de tren = the train station
el aeropuerto = the airport
el puerto = the port

Useful phrases:
¿Cuánto cuesta el billete? = How much is the ticket?
Quiero un billete a... = I want a ticket to...
¿A qué hora sale...? = What time does... leave?
¿A qué hora llega...? = What time does... arrive?
El tren sale a las... = The train leaves at...
El tren llega a las... = The train arrives at...

Verbs related to transport:
subir al autobús/tren = to get on the bus/train
bajar del autobús/tren = to get off the bus/train
esperar la parada = to wait for the stop
cambiar de autobús/tren = to change buses/trains
conducir = to drive
viajar = to travel

Prepositions:
en el autobús = on the bus
en el metro = on the subway
en el tren = on the train
en el taxi = in the taxi
en coche = by car
en bicicleta = by bicycle
examples:
Quiero un billete al aeropuerto. (I want a ticket to the airport.)
¿Cuánto cuesta el billete? (How much is the ticket?)
Cuesta cinco euros. (It costs five euros.)
¿A qué hora sale el autobús? (What time does the bus leave?)
Sale a las ocho de la mañana. (It leaves at eight in the morning.)
Subo al autobús en la parada. (I get on the bus at the stop.)
Bajo en la estación de tren. (I get off at the train station.)
Viajo en metro al centro. (I travel by subway to the center.)
¿Puedo llevar mi bicicleta en el tren? (Can I bring my bicycle on the train?)
Sí, pero en las horas fuera de punta. (Yes, but during off-peak hours.)

grammar.title: Describing Places — Ser and Estar with Locations
grammar.content:
Using SER and ESTAR to describe places:

SER for permanent characteristics of places:
La ciudad es grande. (The city is big.)
La plaza es bonita. (The square is pretty.)
El museo es antiguo. (The museum is old.)
El parque es moderno. (The park is modern.)
La calle es estrecha. (The street is narrow.)
La avenida es larga. (The avenue is long.)

Estar for location:
El museo está en el centro. (The museum is in the center.)
La iglesia está en la plaza. (The church is in the square.)
El parque está al lado del hospital. (The park is next to the hospital.)
La plaza está entre la iglesia y el castillo. (The square is between the church and the castle.)

Combining SER and ESTAR:
La ciudad es bonita y está cerca del mar. (The city is pretty and is near the sea.)
El museo es antiguo y está en el centro. (The museum is old and is in the center.)
La plaza es grande y está al lado del castillo. (The square is big and is next to the castle.)

Useful adjectives for describing places:
bonito/a = pretty
antiguo/a = old
moderno/a = modern
grande = big
pequeño/a = small
amplio/a = spacious
estrecho/a = narrow
largo/a = long
tranquilo/a = quiet
ruidoso/a = noisy
limpio/a = clean
sucio/a = dirty
popular = popular
famoso/a = famous
histórico/a = historic

Questions:
¿Cómo es la ciudad? (What is the city like?)
¿Dónde está el museo? (Where is the museum?)
¿Es grande la plaza? (Is the square big?)
¿Es antiguo el edificio? (Is the building old?)
examples:
La ciudad es bonita. (The city is pretty.)
El pueblo es pequeño y tranquilo. (The town is small and quiet.)
La plaza es grande y está en el centro. (The square is big and is in the center.)
El museo es antiguo y está cerca de la iglesia. (The museum is old and is near the church.)
¿Es famoso el castillo? (Is the castle famous?)
Sí, es muy famoso. (Yes, it's very famous.)
La calle es estrecha pero bonita. (The street is narrow but pretty.)
El parque está al lado del río. (The park is next to the river.)

grammar.title: Quantifiers — Mucho/Poco/Mucho/a
grammar.content:
Using quantifiers to describe how much/many of something is in a place:

Singular (with singular nouns):
mucho/a = a lot of / much
poco/a = a little / few
muy = very
bastante = quite a lot / fairly

Plural (with plural nouns):
muchos/muchas = a lot of / many
pocos/pocas = a few / little
bastantes = quite a few

Examples:
La ciudad tiene mucho tráfico. (The city has a lot of traffic.)
Hay pocos restaurantes aquí. (There are few restaurants here.)
En el parque hay muchos árboles. (In the park there are many trees.)
Hay bastante gente en la plaza. (There is quite a lot of people in the square.)
No hay mucho ruido en esta calle. (There isn't much noise on this street.)
En el centro hay muchos turistas. (In the center there are many tourists.)

Combined with hay:
Hay mucho/a + singular noun = there is a lot of + singular
Hay muchos/muchas + plural noun = there are a lot of + plural
No hay + singular/plural = there is/are not any

Questions:
¿Hay mucho tráfico? (Is there a lot of traffic?)
¿Hay muchos museos aquí? (Are there many museums here?)
¿Hay poca gente? (Is there little people / are there few people?)
examples:
En esta ciudad hay mucho tráfico. (In this city there is a lot of traffic.)
En el pueblo hay poca gente. (In the town there are few people.)
Hay muchos parques en el centro. (There are many parks in the center.)
Hay poco ruido en esta calle. (There is little noise on this street.)
¿Hay bastante comida en el restaurante? (Is there quite a lot of food in the restaurant?)
En la plaza hay bastantes turistas. (In the square there are quite a few tourists.)
No hay mucho tráfico los domingos. (There isn't much traffic on Sundays.)
¿Hay muchos autobuses? (Are there many buses?)

grammar.title: Expressing Distance and Time
grammar.content:
Talking about how far places are and how long it takes to get there:

Distance expressions:
está cerca = it's near
está lejos = it's far
está muy cerca = it's very near
está muy lejos = it's very far
está a dos manzanas = it's two blocks away
está a cinco minutos = it's five minutes (away)
está a diez minutos a pie = it's ten minutes on foot
está a diez minutos en coche = it's ten minutes by car

Time expressions:
una hora = one hour
media hora = half an hour
cinco minutos = five minutes
diez minutos = ten minutes
dos horas = two hours

Combining distance and time:
¿Cuánto tarda en llegar a...? = How long does it take to get to...?
Tarda veinte minutos. (It takes twenty minutes.)
Tarda media hora en autobús. (It takes half an hour by bus.)
Tarda diez minutos a pie. (It takes ten minutes on foot.)

Prepositions for transport:
en autobús = by bus
en metro = by subway
en tren = by train
en coche = by car
en bicicleta = by bicycle
a pie = on foot
en taxi = by taxi

Questions:
¿Cuánto tarda? = How long does it take?
¿Es lejos? = Is it far?
¿Puedo ir a pie? = Can I go on foot?
¿Cuánto cuesta el billete? = How much is the ticket?
¿Cuántas paradas hay? = How many stops are there?
¿Cuántas calles hay que cruzar? = How many streets do I have to cross?
examples:
¿Cuánto tarda en llegar al aeropuerto? (How long does it take to get to the airport?)
Tarda media hora en coche. (It takes half an hour by car.)
¿Es lejos de aquí? (Is it far from here?)
No, está cerca. (No, it's near.)
¿Puedo ir a pie? (Can I go on foot?)
Sí, está a diez minutos a pie. (Yes, it's ten minutes on foot.)
¿Cuánto tarda el autobús? (How long does the bus take?)
Tarda veinte minutos. (It takes twenty minutes.)
¿Cuántas paradas hay hasta el centro? (How many stops to the center?)
Hay cinco paradas. (There are five stops.)
¿Cuánto cuesta el billete del metro? (How much is the subway ticket?)
Cuesta dos euros. (It costs two euros.)

exercises.question: What is 'church' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Iglesia' = church. 'Museo' = museum. 'Biblioteca' = library. 'Hospital' = hospital.

exercises.question: What is 'subway' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Metro' = subway. 'Autobús' = bus. 'Tren' = train. 'Taxi' = taxi.

exercises.question: Complete: ¿Dónde está la ___? (Where is the church?)
exercises.explanation: 'Iglesia' = church. The question '¿Dónde está...?' uses 'estar' for location.

exercises.question: Complete: Gire a la ___. (Turn right.)
exercises.explanation: 'Derecha' = right. 'Gire a la derecha' = Turn right. 'Izquierda' = left.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Where is the bank?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Dónde' = where. 'Está' = is (location). 'El banco' = the bank. Use ESTAR for location questions.

exercises.question: What does 'izquierda' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Izquierda' = left. 'Derecha' = right. 'Derecho' = straight. 'Arriba' = up.

exercises.question: Complete: Siga todo ___. (Go straight ahead.)
exercises.explanation: 'Todo recto' = straight ahead. 'Siga' is the formal command of 'seguir' (to follow).

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The museum is in the center'
exercises.correct: el museo está en el centro
exercises.explanation: 'El museo' = the museum. 'Está' = is (location). 'En el centro' = in the center. Use ESTAR for location.

exercises.question: What is 'train station' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Estación de tren' = train station. 'Parada de autobús' = bus stop. 'Aeropuerto' = airport. 'Estación de metro' = subway station.

exercises.question: Complete: Cruce la ___. (Cross the street.)
exercises.explanation: 'Calle' = street. 'Cruce la calle' = cross the street. 'Cruce' is the formal command of 'cruzar' (to cross).

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Is there a pharmacy nearby?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Hay' = is there. 'Una farmacia' = a pharmacy. 'Cerca' = nearby. 'Hay' is the impersonal 'there is/are'.

exercises.question: What is 'airplane' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Avión' = airplane (with accent on ó). 'Barco' = boat. 'Autobús' = bus. 'Tren' = train.

exercises.question: Complete: La plaza está ___ el castillo. (The square is next to the castle.)
exercises.explanation: 'Al lado del' = next to the (al lado de + el = al lado del). 'Al lado de' = next to.

exercises.question: What does 'cerca' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Cerca' = near/close. 'Lejos' = far. 'Arriba' = above/up. 'Detrás' = behind.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'How much is the ticket?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuánto cuesta' = how much does it cost. 'El billete' = the ticket. You can also say 'el boleto'.

exercises.question: What is 'square' (public plaza) in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Plaza' = square/public plaza. 'Calle' = street. 'Avenida' = avenue. 'Centro' = center.

exercises.question: Complete: El parque está ___ la iglesia. (The park is opposite the church.)
exercises.explanation: 'Enfrente de' = opposite of. 'El parque está enfrente de la iglesia' = The park is opposite the church.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The city is big and beautiful'
exercises.correct: la ciudad es grande y bonita
exercises.explanation: 'La ciudad' = the city. 'Es' = is (permanent characteristic, from SER). 'Grande' = big. 'Bonita' = beautiful. Use SER for descriptions of size/appearance.

exercises.question: What is 'sidewalk' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Acera' = sidewalk. 'Calle' = street. 'Plaza' = square. 'Esquina' = corner.

exercises.question: Complete: Hay ___ tráfico en esta ciudad. (There is a lot of traffic in this city.)
exercises.explanation: 'Mucho' = a lot of (used with masculine singular nouns). 'Tráfico' is masculine, so 'mucho tráfico' = a lot of traffic.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Turn left at the corner'
exercises.correct: gire a la izquierda en la esquina
exercises.explanation: 'Gire' = turn (formal command). 'A la izquierda' = to the left. 'En la esquina' = at the corner.

exercises.question: What is 'castle' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Castillo' = castle. 'Iglesia' = church. 'Palacio' = palace. 'Catedral' = cathedral.

exercises.question: Complete: Voy en ___ al centro. (I go by bus to the center.)
exercises.explanation: 'Autobús' = bus. 'Voy en autobús' = I go by bus. 'Voy' = I go (from 'ir').

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'It's far from the center'
exercises.explanation: 'Está' = is (location, from ESTAR). 'Lejos' = far. 'Del' = de + el = from the. 'Centro' = center.

exercises.question: What is 'library' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Biblioteca' = library. 'Museo' = museum. 'Librería' = bookstore. 'Tienda' = shop.

exercises.question: Complete: El museo está al ___ del parque. (The museum is next to the park.)
exercises.explanation: 'Al lado de' = next to. 'El museo está al lado del parque' = The museum is next to the park.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'How long does it take to get there?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuánto tarda' = how long does it take. 'En llegar' = to get/arrive. 'Allí' = there.

exercises.question: What is 'pharmacy' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Farmacia' = pharmacy. 'Hospital' = hospital. 'Clínica' = clinic. 'Doctor' = doctor.

exercises.question: Complete: Necesito un ___ para el tren. (I need a ticket for the train.)
exercises.explanation: 'Billete' = ticket. 'Boleto' is also used in Latin America. 'Necesito' = I need.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The bridge is over the river'
exercises.correct: el puente está sobre el río
exercises.explanation: 'El puente' = the bridge. 'Está' = is (location). 'Sobre' = over/above. 'El río' = the river.

exercises.question: What is 'tower' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Torre' = tower. 'Castillo' = castle. 'Iglesia' = church. 'Muralla' = wall.

exercises.question: Complete: Hay ___ museos en esta ciudad. (There are few museums in this city.)
exercises.explanation: 'Pocos' = few (used with masculine plural nouns). 'Museos' is masculine plural, so 'pocos museos' = few museums.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'I want a ticket to the airport'
exercises.explanation: 'Quiero' = I want. 'Un billete' = a ticket. 'Al' = a + el = to the. 'Aeropuerto' = airport.

exercises.question: What does 'todo recto' mean?
exercises.explanation: 'Todo recto' = go straight ahead. 'Gire a la izquierda' = turn left. 'Gire a la derecha' = turn right. 'Vuelva atrás' = go back.

exercises.question: Complete: Disculpe, ¿dónde está la ___ de tren? (Excuse me, where is the train station?)
exercises.explanation: 'Estación de tren' = train station. 'Disculpe' = excuse me (polite). '¿Dónde está...?' = where is...?

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The town is small and quiet'
exercises.correct: el pueblo es pequeño y tranquilo
exercises.explanation: 'El pueblo' = the town. 'Es' = is (description, from SER). 'Pequeño' = small. 'Tranquilo' = quiet. Both adjectives agree in masculine singular with 'pueblo'.

exercises.question: What is 'bicycle' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Bicicleta' = bicycle. 'Coche' = car. 'Motocicleta' = motorcycle. 'Autobús' = bus.

exercises.question: Complete: La farmacia está ___ la esquina. (The pharmacy is at the corner.)
exercises.explanation: 'En la esquina' = at the corner. 'La farmacia está en la esquina' = The pharmacy is at the corner.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'The museum is old and beautiful'
exercises.correct: el museo es antiguo y bonito
exercises.explanation: 'El museo' = the museum. 'Es' = is (permanent characteristics, from SER). 'Antiguo' = old. 'Bonito' = beautiful. Both masculine singular to agree with 'museo'.

exercises.question: What is 'supermarket' in Spanish?
exercises.explanation: 'Supermercado' = supermarket. 'Mercado' = market. 'Tienda' = shop. 'Farmacia' = pharmacy.

exercises.question: Complete: No hay ___ tráfico los domingos. (There isn't much traffic on Sundays.)
exercises.explanation: 'Mucho' = much/a lot of. 'No hay mucho' = there isn't much. 'Mucho' is used with masculine singular 'tráfico'.

exercises.question: Translate to Spanish: 'Can you tell me how to get to the museum?'
exercises.explanation: '¿Puede decirme' = can you tell me. 'Cómo' = how. 'Llegar al' = to get to (the). 'Museo' = museum. This is the formal 'usted' form.
